items.headline: McDavid chases a ghost — he just matched a 40-year-old Gretzky record
items.body: Connor McDavid had a goal and two assists as the Oilers beat the Flyers 5-2, and in doing so tied a mark Wayne Gretzky set back in 1984-85: fastest player ever to 40 assists in a season, both getting there in just 22 games. Edmonton's now won five straight.
items.say: Did you see McDavid tied one of Gretzky's old records — fastest to 40 assists in a season? Chasing the Great One himself. You follow any hockey?

items.headline: Mahomes throws five — the Chiefs bury the Falcons
items.body: Patrick Mahomes tossed five touchdown passes as Kansas City rolled past Atlanta 35-13 on Sunday, pulling the Chiefs into a first-place tie in the AFC West. Vintage Mahomes, carving up a struggling Falcons defense.
items.say: Mahomes threw five touchdowns Sunday — Chiefs blew out the Falcons. The guy just doesn't slow down. You riding with anybody in the NFL this year?

items.headline: Luka's at it again — 43 as the Lakers down the Suns
items.body: Luka Dončić poured in 43 points with nine assists and five made threes to lead the Lakers to a 131-123 win in Phoenix. He's been on an absolute tear to start the season.
items.say: Luka dropped 43 on the Suns Sunday night — dude's playing out of his mind right now. You catching any NBA this season?

items.headline: United make their move — Pochettino closing in on the Old Trafford job
items.body: Manchester United are reportedly on the verge of hiring Mauricio Pochettino as their next manager, with current boss Michael Carrick set to be let go. It would hand the well-traveled Argentine one of the biggest — and most pressure-packed — jobs in world football.
items.say: Sounds like Man United are about to hire Pochettino as manager — that's one of the toughest jobs in sports these days. You follow the Premier League at all?

items.headline: FURIA do it again — Brazilians sweep Spirit to defend their Hong Kong crown
items.body: FURIA blanked Team Spirit 3-0 to win BLAST Rivals in Hong Kong for the second year running, with KSCERATO named MVP. Spirit were the favorites coming in, so it's a real statement run heading into CS2's season-ending Major.
items.say: Brazil's FURIA just swept the big Counter-Strike event in Hong Kong — 3-0 in the final. They're red-hot going into the Major. You play any CS, or watch it?

links.text: GRAND FINAL: Spirit vs FURIA — highlights (BLAST)

items.headline: Grammy season is here — Raye leads, and Ella Langley sweeps the Big Four
items.body: The 2027 Grammy nominations dropped today. British singer Raye tops the field with 11 nods, Rosalía follows with nine, and country breakout Ella Langley pulled off a rare feat — the only artist nominated in all four top categories. The ceremony is February 7.
items.say: Grammy nominations came out today — Raye's leading, and that country singer Ella Langley is up for all the big awards. Always fun to argue the snubs. Who do you think got robbed?

items.headline: Scary Scrooge wins the weekend — 'Ebenezer' tops the box office
items.body: Ti West's horror-tinged take on 'A Christmas Carol,' with Johnny Depp as a snarling Scrooge, opened at No. 1 with about $19 million — holding off 'The Cat in the Hat' and 'Godzilla Minus Zero.' A spooky spin on the holiday classic clearly found its crowd.
items.say: That horror version of A Christmas Carol with Johnny Depp actually won the box office this weekend. A scary Scrooge — kind of a fun idea, right? You seen it?

items.headline: 'They Called Me Hootie' — Darius Rucker's story hits Hulu today
items.body: The new documentary on Darius Rucker — Hootie & the Blowfish frontman turned country star — starts streaming today on Hulu. With pals like Woody Harrelson chiming in, it traces his wild ride from '90s pop-rock juggernaut to Nashville. Serious '90s nostalgia.
items.say: There's a new Darius Rucker documentary out today — the Hootie & the Blowfish guy. Man, 'Only Wanna Be with You' was everywhere in the '90s. You remember Hootie?

links.text: Hootie & The Blowfish — Only Wanna Be with You (Official Video)

items.headline: Gracie Abrams keeps her big year rolling — deluxe album out Friday
items.body: One of pop's biggest young stars expands her latest album with a deluxe edition this Friday, right as Grammy season kicks off. If 'That's So True' got stuck in your head, you already know the vibe — diary-pop built for singing along.
items.say: Gracie Abrams has new music out Friday — she's absolutely massive with the younger crowd right now. You heard 'That's So True'? It was inescapable.
